title: MapUnite bike profile bundle
description: One bike variant (kind=variant) or one powertrain x segment fallback (kind=class_default). All quantities are SI (UCUM unit codes) and carry provenance and confidence. Structure only: physics cross-checks and source-id resolution are enforced by public/js/bikedb/validate.js. Generated by scripts/build-bike-schema.mjs — do not edit by hand.
